title: Song Food voice/audio filenames

glossary.meaning: The clip identity (line / piece name). Always leads the basename.
Pitch raised by 8 semitones from the default.
Pitch lowered by 4 semitones from the default.
Playback speed increased by 20% from the default.
Playback speed decreased by 10% from the default.
En dash separating identity from non-default pitch/speed phrases (speakable style only).
Machine-safe twin separator between identity and modifier segments.

rules_summary: Identity first; then pitch; then speed.
Omit default pitch and default speed from the basename.
Hash is never the basename; optional short suffix only after human labels.
Folders by identity are optional; the basename still repeats the identity.

files.note: Optional machine-safe twin of the pitch+speed speakable name.
